environment.description: ECS Fargate service running with task role 'ws-service-role-prod' that has DynamoDB permissions scoped with leading-key condition. The IAM policy uses dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition with a substitution variable referencing the request context tag 'aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_id' which is set via STS session tags propagated from the OIDC provider federation. The condition enforces that the partition key ('pk') attribute in any GetItem or UpdateItem request MUST begin with 'TENANT#${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_id}#'. Additionally, a DynamoDB VPC endpoint policy attached to the interface endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e) restricts dynamodb:UpdateItem calls to only allow ExpressionAttributeNames that do NOT include 'tenant_id' via a StringNotLike condition on dynamodb:Attributes with pattern '*tenant_id*'. The task role also has a permissions boundary (pb-ws-service) that explicitly denies dynamodb:* when dynamodb:LeadingKeys does not match the principal tag pattern.

config.sts_session_tags: tenant_id set from OIDC claim at federation time, immutable
config.vpc_endpoint_policy: vpce-0a1b2c3d4e policy: Deny dynamodb:UpdateItem when StringLike dynamodb:Attributes '*tenant_id*'
config.permissions_boundary: pb-ws-service: Deny dynamodb:* unless dynamodb:LeadingKeys matches TENANT#${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_id}#*
config.network: Private subnet, VPC endpoint only, no internet gateway
